difficulty_reason: In the situation of a morphism with a section, the lemma shows that the connected component X^0 along the section is locally constructible when the morphism is finitely presented. The proof analyses X^0 through the section, expresses membership in the component by a finite-type condition on the fibres, and then applies the constructibility criterion for such conditions for finitely presented morphisms. Turning membership in the component into a finite-type condition is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 8275-8307.
